name: microsoft-teams-mcp
description: Microsoft Teams for Claude — read any chat or channel, your unread messages, and their attachments, and send messages and reactions (each confirmed first), via your signed-in browser

ws_port.title: Bridge WebSocket port (optional)
ws_port.description: Optional. fetchproxy concentrator port used for the browser bridge. Defaults to 37149, the fleet-wide shared port. Leave blank for the default.

fetchproxy_ws_host.title: Bridge bind interface (optional, hosted only)
fetchproxy_ws_host.description: Optional. Bind interface for the bridge (default 127.0.0.1; a literal IP only, anything else is ignored). Keep on loopback — it exists for ONE topology: a hosted child in its own network namespace. Leave blank.

fetchproxy_identity_dir.title: Bridge identity directory (optional, hosted only)
fetchproxy_identity_dir.description: Optional. Where to store the long-term fetchproxy identity keypair (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/; an absolute path only, anything else is ignored). Exists for a host that runs a separate child per caller, so they can share one identity. Leave blank.

access_token.title: Teams access token (optional)
access_token.description: Optional. A pre-obtained Teams chat-service bearer token (the JWT itself). Leave blank to capture one from your signed-in Teams browser tab via the ContextMint Bridge extension.

disable_fetchproxy.title: Disable browser token capture (optional)
disable_fetchproxy.description: Optional. Set to true to never capture a token from the browser; then TEAMS_ACCESS_TOKEN is required. Leave blank.

chatsvc_region.title: Chat-service region (optional)
chatsvc_region.description: Optional. The Teams chat-service region in the API path. Defaults to amer. Leave blank unless your tenant lives elsewhere.

chatsvc_base.title: Chat-service base URL (optional)
chatsvc_base.description: Optional. Full override for the chat-service API base (default https://teams.cloud.microsoft/api/chatsvc/<region>/v1). Leave blank.

capture_timeout.title: Token capture timeout (optional)
capture_timeout.description: Optional. Seconds to wait for the Teams tab to issue a chat-service request when capturing a token. Defaults to 30.

token_cache.title: Token cache (optional)
token_cache.description: Optional. Set to false to keep the captured token in memory only. Defaults to on: it is cached so a restart within its ~23h lifetime needs no browser.

token_file.title: Token cache file (optional)
token_file.description: Optional. Where the captured token is cached. Defaults to ~/.microsoft-teams-mcp/token.json.

time_zone.title: Time zone (optional)
time_zone.description: Optional. Default IANA time zone (e.g. America/New_York) for the tz argument of teams_read_conversation and teams_get_unread: each message then carries time_local next to its UTC time. Leave blank for UTC only.

confirm_mode.title: Write confirmation mode (optional)
confirm_mode.description: Optional. What the writes (teams_send_message, teams_react, teams_mark_read and the read tools' mark_read) do on a client that cannot show a confirmation prompt (claude.ai, Claude Desktop): "ask-user" (default: the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and the model must get your approval in chat before using it), "auto" (the model may use the token after reviewing the preview itself) or "refuse". An unrecognised value is treated as refuse. Leave blank for the default.

confirm_elicitation.title: Confirmation prompts (optional)
confirm_elicitation.description: Optional. "off" never shows a confirmation prompt, so every client gets the MCP_CONFIRM_MODE flow. Set it for a client that says it can show prompts but never does. Defaults to on. Leave blank for the default.

confirm_ttl_seconds.title: Confirmation token lifetime (optional)
confirm_ttl_seconds.description: Optional. How long a confirmToken stays valid, in seconds. Defaults to 600. Leave blank for the default.

confirm_secret.title: Confirmation signing key (optional)
confirm_secret.description: Optional. Signing key for confirmTokens. Random per process by default; set it only if tokens must survive a server restart. Leave blank for the default.

tools.name: teams_list_chats
tools.description: List every chat (group, meeting, 1:1) the signed-in user is in, with unread state

tools.name: teams_list_teams_and_channels
tools.description: List every channel the signed-in user is in, by team, with unread state

tools.name: teams_read_conversation
tools.description: Read any chat or channel by id or name — leaves it unread unless you ask it to mark it read (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: teams_get_unread
tools.description: Get every unread message across chats and channels — leaves them unread unless you ask it to mark them read (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: teams_get_changes
tools.description: List the chats and channels with new messages since a cursor (default the last 24 hours), with counts and the channel threads that got replies

tools.name: teams_get_attachment
tools.description: Fetch a message's inline image, or download a shared file's contents from SharePoint (metadata and open link when it cannot be fetched)

tools.name: teams_send_message
tools.description: Post a message (with quote-replies, @mentions and emoji) to any chat or channel — asks you to confirm first

tools.name: teams_react
tools.description: Add or remove your reaction on any message — asks you to confirm first

tools.name: teams_mark_read
tools.description: Mark a chat or channel read up to a message, clearing its unread badge (never backwards) — asks you to confirm first

tools.name: teams_get_activity
tools.description: Read the Activity feed — mentions, reactions, replies, meeting notices and missed calls across every chat and channel, without opening it

tools.name: teams_healthcheck
tools.description: Verify the Teams chat-service token and API, end-to-end
